description: This file defines a static class 'CertificateLoader' that provides methods to load and validate X509 certificates from the certificate store, specifically for TLS server and client authentication purposes. It includes logic to filter certificates based on Extended Key Usage extensions, and handles certificate disposal.

classes.name: CertificateLoader
classes.description: A static utility class for loading and validating X509 certificates from certificate stores, primarily used for setting up TLS authentication.

methods.name: LoadFromStoreCert
methods.description: Loads a certificate from the specified store by subject name, filtering by validity and purpose (server or client authentication), and ordering by expiration date.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForServerAuth
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is valid for server authentication based on Extended Key Usage extension.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate is valid for client authentication based on Extended Key Usage extension.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForKeyUsage
methods.description: Internal method that verifies if a certificate's Extended Key Usage extension includes the specified purpose OID, or assumes all usages are allowed if the extension is absent.

methods.name: DoesCertificateHaveAnAccessiblePrivateKey
methods.description: Checks whether the certificate has an accessible private key.

methods.name: DisposeCertificates
methods.description: Disposes of all certificates in a collection except a specified one.
